title: [spec-gap][R-02AT-007] 02a-tdma.md beacon wire format stale vs decision rule-0x08 and implemented 24B header
description: Spec 02a-tdma.md:23-30 defines beacon content as: Type 1B 0xBE; SFN u32; Timestamp u32; Stratum u8 (0=GNSS,1=mesh); N_slots u8 default 8-32; slot bitmap or assigned list; Next beacon delta u16 ms; and line 23 says SCHC-compressed on CH0. Classification: divergent. All three stacks implement the 24-byte fixed uncompressed header (epoch u32, num_slots u8, sfn u32, timestamp u32, flags u8, rx_chains u8, setup_window u16, occupied_time u16, guard u8, channel_mask u32) + CBOR slot_map + trailing 48B Schnorr48 sig: rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs:84-131, python/src/lichen/rpl/tdma_beacon.py:46-123, lichen/subsys/lichen/link/beacon.c:26-98 (layout doc beacon.h:12-24). No 0xBE type byte exists in any code (only hit is the spec line itself); stratum rides the DIO Time option 0x15, not the beacon; no next_beacon_delta wire field (beacon_delta_ms is only a drift function: python/src/lichen/timing/ccp7.py:14, rust/lichen-link/src/tdma_clock.rs:12); no slot bitmap (CBOR slot_map list only). The SCHC-on-CH0 claim contradicts adjudicated decision rule-0x08-tdma-beacon in spec/decisions.jsonl (beacon is fixed-format uncompressed). R-02AT-008: N_slots default 8 is implemented (lichen_tdma_compute_slot tdma.c:53, ccp.py:434) but the 8-32 upper bound is enforced nowhere (only nonzero checks, rust tdma_beacon.rs:123-125). Suggested placement: amend spec/02a-tdma.md lines 23-30 to reference the coordinated-capacity 2a.2 uncompressed layout (coordinate with existing bead project-LICHEN-worker6-0aod which aligns 02a-coordinated-capacity.md), drop or explicitly re-add next-beacon-delta and beacon-stratum as new wire fields, and either pin the 8-32 range in all parsers or make the spec say nonzero-u8. From spec-coverage sweep 2026-09-09 (docs/spec-coverage/02a-tdma.md R-02AT-007/008).
close_reason: Amended spec/02a-tdma.md:23-30: stale beacon wire format (0xBE type byte, stratum field, N_slots 8-32, slot bitmap, next-beacon-delta, 'SCHC-compressed on CH0') replaced with the adjudicated uncompressed layout per decision rule-0x08-tdma-beacon (spec/decisions.jsonl, decided by Mark 2026-08-31; 4e0t closed): fixed 24-byte header (epoch/num_slots/sfn/timestamp/flags/rx_chains/setup_window/occupied_time/guard/channel_mask) + CBOR slot_map (sorted list, not bitmap) + 48B Schnorr48 sig, normative reference to 02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.2 (already amended). Stratum explicitly noted as riding DIO Time option 0x15 (09-packets-timing), not the beacon; no type byte / no next-beacon-delta field. R-02AT-008: spec now says num_slots nonzero u8 default 8 (matches all 3 parsers: Rust NumSlotsZero, Python nonzero raise, C num_slots==0U reject); the nonzero MUST-reject was also added to the normative table at 02a-coordinated-capacity.md section 2a.2 (round-2 review finding: constraint must live in the normative table, not only the summary). Upper-bound pinning option filed as ypb1 for Mark. Codereview loop (delegated): r1 correctness PASS, security 3 findings (2 -> comment on human bead b7z9.160; 1 -> ypb1), edge 4 findings (1bf9 filed; 3 fixed inline); r2: 2 findings (1 fixed inline - timestamp role is epoch_floor validation, drift uses arrival times; 1 -> t92f for 09-packets-timing.md:668); r3: PASS, converged. Spec-text-only; no code tests apply.
